EDUCATOR FEEDBACK & ACTIONABLE INSIGHTS
This submission demonstrates a strong understanding of multi-factor authentication (MFA) and its role in cybersecurity. The essay effectively outlines various MFA methods, discusses their trade-offs, and integrates MFA into broader security strategies, particularly zero-trust models. The analysis of attack vectors and countermeasures is insightful. To further enhance the submission, consider elaborating on specific case studies of data breaches where MFA was either effective or bypassed, and provide more detailed examples of how human factors can be addressed through training and policy. Overall, this is a well-written and comprehensive response.
